//: Keys starting with // are comments and are ignored. An empty string "" means: inherit. Trailing commas are tolerated.
//global: Settings for the page and between badges (cannot be set per type).

global.//dir: Folder inside the wiki that receives the generated SVG files.
global.//align: Vertical alignment of a badge in the text line (): baseline, middle, absmiddle, absbottom, texttop, top, bottom.
global.//height: Height of a badge in px (GitHub's body text is 16 px); everything else scales with it.
global.//codeHeight: Height inside a code span (GitHub renders code at 85 %); set equal to height for one size everywhere.
global.//fontSize: Text size as a multiple of the badge height.
global.//baseline: Baseline below the badge centre as a multiple of the text size (centres the x-height).
global.//radius: Corner radius as a multiple of the height (0 = square corners).
global.//padding: Space between the badge edge and the text, as a multiple of the height.
global.//altGap: Between the badges of alternatives ([str/num]); a gap that is only white space is dropped inside code spans (monospace would show it as a full space). | or / are visible alternatives.
global.//tableMinWidth: A table column of badge-only cells gets its header widened so the column cannot shrink the images.
global.//only_named_badges: true: a [name] becomes a badge only if the name is listed in colors_per_badge. false: every [name] becomes a badge (of type default or other if named there).
global.//strict_name_check: false: a name is letters, digits, _ . -; other characters before/after it are decoration kept in the badge text ([str++] is a str badge reading str++), / separates alternatives, (...) groups them. true: everything between [ ] is the name as written, / and () have no meaning, so str{} must be listed itself.

//defaults: Settings every badge inherits; a type (type_specs) may override any of them.

defaults.//color: Background colour of a badge whose name has no entry in colors_per_badge.
defaults.//scale: Size factor: the badge is height * scale (codeHeight * scale in code spans) high.
defaults.//shift: Fine positioning as a multiple of the height: positive moves the badge up, negative down.
defaults.//codeShift: The same inside code spans (default: shift).
defaults.//badgesInCodeSpans: Tokens inside `code spans` become badges too (fenced code blocks never).
defaults.//icon: SVG file next to this json (empty double quotes = no icon), see README. rotate in degrees; height, padding (left of the icon) and gap (between icon and text) as multiples of the badge height; color applies only if the SVG uses currentColor.

//type_specs: Badge types. 'default' ([name] tokens) and 'file' (page links [**name**](name.md)) always exist; add any other type as a group of names with their own settings. A name belongs to the first type that lists it in colors_per_badge.
//colors_per_badge: Background colour per badge name, grouped by type. Names under 'file' are page names.
